canonical_example.text: Acabamos de contratar a un nuevo abogado.
canonical_example.translation: We just hired a new lawyer.

canonical_example.text: Lo contrataron como camarero en un restaurante.
canonical_example.translation: He's been taken on as a waiter in a restaurant.

canonical_example.text: Han contratado al jugador para otra temporada.
canonical_example.translation: The player has been signed for another season.

canonical_example.text: Contrataron varias obras.
canonical_example.translation: Several works were put out to contract.

canonical_example.text: Hay pocos animales más feroces que el león.
canonical_example.translation: There are few animals fiercer than the lion.

canonical_example.text: Los hipopótamos son más feroces de lo que parecen.
canonical_example.translation: Hippos are more ferocious than they look.

canonical_example.text: Su mirada feroz lo decía todo.
canonical_example.translation: His violent look said it all.

canonical_example.text: El detective logró atrapar al asesino feroz.
canonical_example.translation: The detective managed to catch the vicious killer.

canonical_example.text: Según las tropas, el general es un hombre feroz.
canonical_example.translation: According to the troops, the general is a cruel man.

canonical_example.text: Los nómadas caminaron horas bajo el feroz sol del desierto.
canonical_example.translation: The nomads walked for hours beneath the fierce desert sun.

canonical_example.text: Su amigo no era tan feroz como lo describían.
canonical_example.translation: His friend wasn't as ugly as he's been described.

canonical_example.text: Me decían que su novia era feroz, pero yo la encontré guapa.
canonical_example.translation: I was told that his girlfriend was horrendous, but I thought she was beautiful.

canonical_example.text: En ese restaurante, sacan la basura cinco veces al día.
canonical_example.translation: At that restaurant they take out the trash five times a day.

canonical_example.text: Sacó un fajo de billetes del bolsillo.
canonical_example.translation: He got out a wad of bills out of his pocket.

canonical_example.text: ¿Nos sacarías una foto a Gerard Piqué y a mí?
canonical_example.translation: Would you take a photo of Gerard Piqué and me?

canonical_example.text: Sacó el primer premio del concurso.
canonical_example.translation: He got first prize in the contest.

canonical_example.text: Abre la boca y saca la lengua.
canonical_example.translation: Open your mouth and stick out your tongue.

canonical_example.text: Lo que sacamos de esta discusión es que es culpable.
canonical_example.translation: What we draw from this discussion is that she is guilty.

canonical_example.text: Tiene uno de los mejores saques en toda la liga de tenis.
canonical_example.translation: She has one of the best serves in the entire tennis league.

canonical_example.text: Saca la mochila del sofá.
canonical_example.translation: Get your backpack off the sofa.

canonical_example.text: Hay varias maneras de sacar una astilla con la ayuda de unas pinzas.
canonical_example.translation: There are several ways to remove a splinter with the aid of tweezers.

canonical_example.text: Quiero sacar una copia del anuncio en el periódico.
canonical_example.translation: I want to make a copy of the ad in the newspaper.

canonical_example.text: El mejor jarabe de arce se saca de árboles en Canadá.
canonical_example.translation: The best maple syrup is extracted from trees in Canada.

canonical_example.text: Saca el dedo de la boca que ya no eres un bebé.
canonical_example.translation: Take your thumb out of your mouth; you're not a baby any more.

canonical_example.text: Mi banda favorita sacó su disco nuevo.
canonical_example.translation: My favorite band released their new album.

canonical_example.text: ¿Sacaste el número total de invitados?
canonical_example.translation: Did you get the total number of guests?

canonical_example.text: Nadal sacó en el sexto juego del cuarto set.
canonical_example.translation: Nadal served in the sixth game of the fourth set.

canonical_example.text: Sácate el abrigo que hace calor.
canonical_example.translation: Take your coat off; it's hot.

canonical_example.text: Sácate los pies de encima de la mesa.
canonical_example.translation: Take your feet off the table.

canonical_example.text: No me saqué las manos de los bolsillos en toda la noche por el frío que hacía.
canonical_example.translation: I didn't take my hands out of my pockets all night because it was so cold.

canonical_example.text: ¡Sácate de aquí antes de que venga la policía!
canonical_example.translation: Get out of here before the police come!

canonical_example.text: Federico gana el punto y el saque vuelve a Galaal.
canonical_example.translation: Federico wins the point, and service returns to Galaal.

canonical_example.text: Al principio del partido, los jugadores fueron al centro del campo para hacer el saque.
canonical_example.translation: At the beginning of the game, the players went to the middle of the field for the kick-off.

canonical_example.text: Mi hijo hace mucho ejercicio y tiene buen saque.
canonical_example.translation: My son exercises a lot and has a hearty appetite.

canonical_example.text: El jugador golpeó fuerte la pelota.
canonical_example.translation: The player hit the ball hard.

canonical_example.text: Lo golpeó en el estómago.
canonical_example.translation: He punched him in the stomach.

canonical_example.text: El pueblo fue golpeado con otra mala noticia ayer.
canonical_example.translation: The town was hit by another piece of bad news yesterday.

canonical_example.text: Me golpeé el pie contra la reja tratando de darle una patada al balón.
canonical_example.translation: I hit my foot against the fence trying to kick the ball.

canonical_example.text: No golpees el cubo de la basura.
canonical_example.translation: Don't bang the trash can.

canonical_example.text: El abogado golpeó la mesa durante el juicio.
canonical_example.translation: The lawyer banged on the table during the trial.

canonical_example.text: Las ramas del árbol golpearon contra la puerta.
canonical_example.translation: The branches of the tree beat against the door.

canonical_example.text: Se golpeó contra la mesa al caerse.
canonical_example.translation: She banged herself on the table when she fell.

canonical_example.text: El pan de esa panadería es buenísimo.
canonical_example.translation: The bread from that bakery is really good.

canonical_example.text: La película estuvo buenísima.
canonical_example.translation: The movie was extremely good.

canonical_example.text: Subir el monte es duro.
canonical_example.translation: Going up the hill is tough.

canonical_example.text: Los prisioneros subieron el muro y escaparon.
canonical_example.translation: The prisoners climbed the wall and escaped.

canonical_example.text: Subieron los impuestos en mi país.
canonical_example.translation: They raised the taxes in my country.

canonical_example.text: Si no subes al autobús ahora lo perderás.
canonical_example.translation: If you don't get on the shuttle now, you'll miss it.

canonical_example.text: Sube al coche y conduce.
canonical_example.translation: Get in the car and drive.

canonical_example.text: Los veo venir subiendo la cuesta.
canonical_example.translation: I can see them coming up the hill.

canonical_example.text: Si tienes frío, podemos subir la calefacción.
canonical_example.translation: If you're cold, we can turn up the heat.

canonical_example.translation: If you want to see the photos, I already uploaded them to my Instagram account.

canonical_example.text: Todavía llueve, pero han subido las temperaturas.
canonical_example.translation: It's still raining, but temperatures have gone up.

canonical_example.translation: The price of a barrel of oil rose five cents last month.

canonical_example.text: Súbete a la escalera para alcanzar mejor.
canonical_example.translation: Go up the ladder so you can reach better.

canonical_example.translation: Look at those kids climbing that tree.

canonical_example.translation: We got up on a bench to get a better view.

canonical_example.translation: I went up the stairs two at a time.

canonical_example.text: Nos subimos la colina para apreciar la vista.
canonical_example.translation: We climbed the hill to enjoy the view.

canonical_example.text: Nos subimos al tren justo cuando estaba a punto de salir.
canonical_example.translation: We got on the train just as it was about to leave.

canonical_example.text: La cerveza se me subió muy rápido.
canonical_example.translation: The beer went to my head pretty fast.

canonical_example.text: Súbete los jeans que se te ven los calzoncillos.
canonical_example.translation: Pull your jeans up because you can see your shorts.

canonical_example.text: Me subí las mangas para amasar el pan.
canonical_example.translation: I rolled up my sleeves to knead the bread.

canonical_example.text: Se dice que su salario anual es de seis cifras.
canonical_example.translation: They say that his annual salary is six figures.

canonical_example.text: La cifra de heridos va en aumento después del terremoto.
canonical_example.translation: The number of injured is on the rise after the earthquake.

canonical_example.text: La cifra total de sus compras es de $2,500.
canonical_example.translation: The total sum of your purchases is $2,500.

canonical_example.text: A ver si descifras los significados secretos que el autor cifró dentro del texto.
canonical_example.translation: See if you can decipher the secret meanings the author has encoded within the text

canonical_example.text: Antes, solía cifrar los mensajes para que nadie los entendiera.
canonical_example.translation: Before, I used to write messages in code so that no one could understand them.

canonical_example.text: Los científicos pueden recuperar la información cifrada en nuestro ADN.
canonical_example.translation: Scientists can retrieve information coded in our DNA.

canonical_example.text: Muchos alumnos cifraron todas sus esperanzas en obtener buenas notas en este examen pero reprobaron.
canonical_example.translation: Many students pinned all their hopes on getting a good result on this exam and they failed.

canonical_example.text: Ciframos nuestras esperanzas en este nuevo producto porque creemos que se venderá bien.
canonical_example.translation: We're pinning our hopes on this new product because we think it will sell well.

canonical_example.text: Los expertos cifran las pérdidas sufridas tras el apagón en cientos de miles de dólares.
canonical_example.translation: Experts estimate losses as a result of the outage at hundreds of thousands of dollars.

canonical_example.text: Es difícil cifrar las ganancias obtenidas tras el cambio de director de la empresa.
canonical_example.translation: It's difficult to calculate the benefits resulting from the company's change of CEO.

canonical_example.text: Inicialmente las pérdidas de la bolsa se cifraban en un cinco por ciento.
canonical_example.translation: Stock market losses initially amounted to five percent.

canonical_example.text: ¿Por qué no contestas la pregunta?
canonical_example.translation: Why don't you answer the question?

canonical_example.text: Sería bonito que me contestaras las cartas alguna vez.
canonical_example.translation: It would be nice if you'd reply to my letters sometime.

canonical_example.text: Estoy intentando comunicarme con la base pero no contestan.
canonical_example.translation: I'm trying to communicate with the base, but there's no reply.

canonical_example.text: No puedo salir a jugar por una semana porque le contesté a mi mamá.
canonical_example.translation: I can't go out to play for a week because I talked back to my mom.

canonical_example.text: Ese chico maleducado siempre anda contestando a los maestros.
canonical_example.translation: That rude boy is always answering back to the teachers.

canonical_example.text: Los estudiantes universitarios contestaron para mostrar su desacuerdo con el alza de las cuotas.
canonical_example.translation: The university students protested to show their disagreement with the fee hike.

canonical_example.text: ¿Por qué nunca contestas cuando te llamo?
canonical_example.translation: Why don't you ever answer when I call you?

canonical_example.text: En la puerta de la tienda había un letrero indicando que estaban cerrados por vacaciones.
canonical_example.translation: There was a sign on the store door saying the it was closed for vacation.

canonical_example.text: Han puesto un letrero diciendo que no se puede nadar allí.
canonical_example.translation: They have put up a notice saying that you cannot swim there.

canonical_example.text: Si el lobo te muerde, te convertirás en un hombre lobo.
canonical_example.translation: If the wolf bites you, you'll turn into a werewolf.

canonical_example.text: El mar muerde las piedras del espigón, gastándolas.
canonical_example.translation: The sea eats into the breakwater's stones, corroding them.

canonical_example.text: El ácido de la batería había mordido elementos del motor.
canonical_example.translation: The acid from the battery had corroded parts of the engine.

canonical_example.text: El policía mordió y se quedó con una parte de las ganancias.
canonical_example.translation: The policeman accepted the bribe and kept a part of the earnings.

canonical_example.text: Cuando estoy inquieta, no puedo parar de morderme las uñas.
canonical_example.translation: When I'm anxious, I can't stop biting my nails.
